# Config: BarStyle

> **Reader:** `BarStyle` (`config/BarStyle.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.BarStyle` · category Look & Feel · scope look

Bar style: How every bar draws its widgets, accents and shadow. A bar can take its own of any of these in the bar editor.

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.


### `BarStyle`

- **`BarStyle.widgetStyle`** · string = "filled" · enum filled|tinted|outline|underline|accentText|plain
  - Widget style: How each widget shows its color: as its background, a faint tint, an outline, a line beside it, or on its icon. Plain text draws them straight onto the bar.
  - x-group="Bar widgets"
  - read: `BarStyle.values` (whole), `barConfig.widgetStyle` · in: `components/bar/WidgetBackground.qml`, `components/bar/WidgetGroup.qml`, `components/bar/widgets/workspaces/ActiveCellIndicator.qml`, `components/bar/widgets/workspaces/CellUnderline.qml`, `components/bar/widgets/workspaces/WorkspaceCell.qml`, `config/Bar.qml`

- **`BarStyle.widgetShape`** · string = "rounded" · enum rounded|capsule|slant|arrow
  - Shape: Rounded follows the widget corner radius. Slanted and arrow widgets take a little more room for their points.

  - Grouping: Merged: neighbouring widgets share one background. Powerline: each widget's shape runs into the next.
